summary: Final review, round 3: pass. Every finding from the last round is closed, and I checked the results myself instead of trusting the reports. From the repo root, `npx playwright test` passes 157/157. That is the 152 from before plus the tester's phone.spec.js, and it includes the exclusive.spec.js Escape regression that was red last round. The /apptest diagram gate `node tests/diagram.js` passes everything, and so do the neighbour suites for index.html that this branch touches (codecopy, mdundo, timeline, cause). `node --check` passes on diagram.js, sketch.js and i18n.js. The stray npm-init package.json in the task folder is gone, and test-report.json now gives real counts. The code meets every decision agreed with the product owner. Flowcharts and mind maps have 8 ports: a pinned end is kept in the text, and an end dropped on the body picks the nearest port. Mind maps have branch drag, per-node colour with a '↺ Branch colour' reset, and '↺ Auto layout' as one undo step. There is a ```sequence kind with participants, messages, dashed replies, self-messages, notes and step numbers, and no frames. The SVG/PNG download has a white background with #222/#444 ink and box colours kept, the PNG is 2×, and the file is named '<chapter slug>-<kind>-<n>'. It saves through ScuLaFolder.save and has buttons both in the modal and on the preview figure, and those buttons are left out of the HTML export. sketch.js has pen, highlighter (multiply at 0.4), eraser, 6 colours, 3 widths, undo/redo, pointer events for touch and stylus, and ✎ on any preview picture that replaces that token as one setRangeText undo step. No dependency was added, the nav block is untouched (no hunk in the branch's index.html diff falls inside it, and phone.spec checks byte-identity), and the Romanian strings keep their diacritics. One thing is left for whoever performs the merge, since this environment refuses `git merge` and `git merge-tree`, both for the implementer and for me. Main has 5 commits the branch lacks (song.html, js/audio/*, tests/verify.js, and the nav edited in every page). Its only overlap with this branch is in docs, plus a nav-only hunk in index.html that this branch does not touch. Expect a textual conflict in CLAUDE.md lines 1–13: keep main's 'Nine' wording and song rows, and keep this branch's index.html row. Also expect conflicts in docs/FEATURES.md (main adds § V, this branch edits § U) and in docs/MAP.md. After the merge, run main's `/verify` (`node tests/verify.js`) and `npm test` once more. Two cosmetic issues are not blocking. The ✎ button stays over a picture until the mouse leaves the preview, rather than as soon as it leaves the picture. The sketch counter 'Schiță n' only counts sketches whose alt text is in the current UI language.
